name: Duolingo
description: Duolingo runs a free game-like language-learning app used by about 140 million people a month (58.7 million daily in Q2 2026). About 9% of monthly users pay for a subscription (12.7 million paid subscribers at 2026-06-30); the subscription tier removes ads and adds features, and is the source of 84% of revenue. The rest comes from advertising to free users, the Duolingo English Test (a paid online English-proficiency exam accepted by universities) and small in-app purchases. Almost all payment flows through Apple, Google and Stripe. It is highly profitable on an operating basis and, until 2026, was growing very fast, but Q2 2026 total bookings growth slowed to 8%.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label from general knowledge, not source-checked. SEC SIC code is 7372 (Services-Prepackaged Software).

businessLines.name: Subscription
businessLines.how: Recurring monthly or annual fee paid by the learner, billed mostly through Apple and Google app stores; revenue recognized over the subscription term, so growth follows paid subscribers and price/tier mix.
businessLines.description: Monthly or annual paid tiers of the app.

businessLines.name: Other (advertising, Duolingo English Test, in-app purchases)
businessLines.how: Advertisers pay to reach free users; test-takers pay a fee per Duolingo English Test; users buy small in-app items. Advertising carries lower margin than subscriptions (10-K).
businessLines.description: 10-K: 'mainly Advertising, Duolingo English Test, and IAPs'; a split between the three was not extracted.
